name: Enemy persona Join, one-title native attempt, official human spy production

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('PREPARE_ENEMY'); return 'enemy Join and one-title preparation queued'

condition.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local a=b.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PREPARE_ENEMY' or a=='UNKNOWN_PREPARE_ENEMY' or a=='REJECTED_PREPARE_ENEMY' then error('enemy Join/title refused after barrier: '..a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PREPARE_ENEMY' and Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_CONFIG')~=nil
local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.EnemyState(); return s.personaState=='GREAT_PERSON' and not s.appointed and s.canAppoint and s.total-s.spent>=1

steps.code: ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('EVOLVE_ENEMY'); return 'regular AI evolution preparation queued after UI title refresh'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_EVOLVE_ENEMY' or a=='UNKNOWN_EVOLVE_ENEMY' or a=='REJECTED_EVOLVE_ENEMY' then error('regular AI evolution refused after barrier: '..a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_EVOLVE_ENEMY' and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO_STATE')=='EVOLVING'

steps.code: local c=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_CONFIG'); local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local s=b.EnemyState(); if c.attacker~=0 or c.owner~=1 or c.source~=2 or s.personaState~='EVOLVING' or s.spent~=c.spent then error('joined enemy actor or title mismatch') end; b.QueueEnemy('APPOINT'); return 'one official cross-player APPOINT requested'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.enemyLast; if a=='ERROR_APPOINT' or a=='UNKNOWN_APPOINT' then error('enemy APPOINT was not judged: '..a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_APPOINT' or a=='REJECTED_APPOINT'

local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.enemyLast; if a=='ERROR_ASSIGN' or a=='UNKNOWN_ASSIGN' then error('enemy ASSIGN was not judged: '..a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_ASSIGN' or a=='REJECTED_ASSIGN' or a=='WAITING_NATIVE_ASSIGN' or a=='ALREADY_NATIVE_ASSIGNED' or a=='ASSIGN_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED' or a=='NATIVE_ASSIGN_UNAVAILABLE'
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_SPAWN_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PREPARED')~=nil

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; b.SpyPrerequisitesReady(); b.Queue('BUILD_SPY'); return 'official BUILD requested once'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BUILD_SPY' or a=='REJECTED_BUILD_SPY' then error(a) end; return a=='READY_BUILD_SPY'
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_PROGRESS_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PROGRESS')~=nil
local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_BIND_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY')~=nil

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local c=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_CONFIG'); local a=b.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='UNKNOWN_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='REJECTED_CONFIRM_ENEMY' then error('enemy native confirmation refused: '..a) end; if a=='QUEUED_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='DISPATCHED_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='BARRIER_SENT_CONFIRM_ENEMY' then return false end; return not c.cityID or a=='ACCEPTED_CONFIRM_ENEMY'

steps.code: local c=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_CONFIG'); if not c.cityID then return 'WAITING_NATIVE' end; return ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.EnemyProgress()
